title.zh: 一个八音盒 = 一个音序器
title.en: A music box is a sequencer

lead.zh: 圆筒转起来，梳齿碰到凸起就发出声音。
lead.en: The drum turns; a tooth that meets a pin sounds.

say.zh: 圆筒转动时，梳齿碰到凸起就发出声音。
say.en: As the drum turns, a tooth of the comb sounds whenever it meets a pin.

say.zh: 把圆筒摊平：从左到右是时间，从下到上是音高，绿线是正在播放的位置。这就是音序器。
say.en: Unroll the drum: time runs left to right, pitch bottom to top, and the green line is what is playing now. That is a sequencer.

say.zh: 点一个空格子，加一个音（就像在圆筒上多装一个凸起），再点一下就去掉。在鸣片上，这 16 个时间格就是机器右边 4×4 的 16 个键，音高用左边的琴键来选。
say.en: Tap an empty cell to add a note (a new pin on the drum); tap it again to take it away. On Cardenza these 16 steps are the 16 keys of the 4×4 block on the right; you pick the pitch on the keyboard to the left.

title.en: Four music boxes make a part

lead.zh: 一个乐器不够，就多买几个。
lead.en: One instrument is not enough: get more.

say.zh: 一个八音盒只有一种声音。
say.en: One music box has one sound.

say.zh: 再来三个：鼓、钢琴、和弦、贝斯，一起播放。
say.en: Add three more: drums, piano, chords, bass, all playing together.

say.zh: 每个八音盒是一条轨道，它转的那一圈叫 Pattern。四轨一起播放，就是一段完整的乐句。
say.en: Each box is a track, and its loop is a pattern. Four tracks playing together make a whole phrase.

title.zh: 很多段排起来 = 一首歌
title.en: Parts in a row make a song

lead.zh: 一段只有几秒，歌要长得多。
lead.en: A part lasts seconds; a song is longer.

say.zh: 一段只有几秒钟。
say.en: One part lasts a few seconds.

say.zh: 多做几段（前奏、A、B……），从左往右一段接一段地播。
say.en: Make a few parts (an intro, A, B…) and play them one after another, left to right.

say.zh: 这就是一首歌（SONG）。每一段里，每条轨道选自己的一个 Pattern（P01、P02……），也可以空着不播（--）。在机器上，它在 {{scene:TAPE}} 场景里排。
say.en: That is a song. In each part every track picks one of its own patterns (P01, P02, …) or stays silent (--). On Cardenza you arrange it in scene {{scene:TAPE}}.

lead.zh: 四个区，各管一件事。
lead.en: Four areas, one job each.

say.zh: 左边 8 列是琴键：按一下，出声。
say.en: The 8 columns on the left are the keyboard: press one to play.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 12; tap r3c3; wait 12; tap r3c5

say.zh: 右边 4×4 对着屏幕中间的格子：点一个，选中它。
say.en: The 4×4 on the right matches the cells on the screen: tap one to pick it.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 或 {{key:SUB}}：改它的值。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} or {{key:SUB}}: change its value.

steps.demo: tap SUB; tap SUB; tap SUB; tap ADD

say.zh: 最左、最右各 4 个键，每个键管一件事。按一按试试：
say.en: The 4 keys at each edge, one job each. Try them:

lead.zh: 弹琴键，换音色。
lead.en: Play the keys, change the sound.

say.zh: 弹琴键：和钢琴一样，下面一行白键，上面一行黑键。
say.en: Play the keys: like a piano, white keys below, black keys above.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c2; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10; tap r2c2; wait 90; shot

say.zh: 弹琴键：现在是 SCALE 排列，每个键都是调里的音。一行是一个八度，从左往右升高，左下角是主音。
say.en: Play the keys: in the SCALE layout every key is a note of the key. A row is an octave, rising left to right, the root at the bottom left.

say.zh: 弹琴键：现在是 CHROMA 排列，每个键都能弹。从左下角起，往右一个键升高半音，一行 8 个，上一行接着往上。
say.en: Play the keys: in the CHROMA layout every key plays. From the bottom left each key to the right is a semitone higher, 8 to a row, the row above going on.

keymarks.zh: 白键，从左下角的 C3 开始
keymarks.en: White keys, from C3 at the bottom left

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 或 {{key:SUB}}：换一个音色，名字在屏幕最上面。
say.en: {{key:ADD}} or {{key:SUB}}: another sound. Its name is at the top of the screen.

say.zh: 再弹一下，听听新音色。
say.en: Play again and hear the new sound.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10; tap r3c5

lead.zh: 大界面叫场景，场景里有好几页。
lead.en: The big screens are scenes; each has pages.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：下一个场景。{{scene:INSTR}} 音色 → {{scene:SEQ}} 音符 → {{scene:TAPE}} 编排。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: the next scene. {{scene:INSTR}} sound → {{scene:SEQ}} notes → {{scene:TAPE}} arrangement.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}} 不放：屏幕变成场景地图，一列一个场景。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}}: the screen becomes a map of the scenes, a column each.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; shot; up ESC

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}}，点 GRID 的一列：直接去那个场景。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}} and tap a GRID column: straight to that scene.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; tap G4; wait 6; shot; up ESC

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：这个场景的下一页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the next page of the scene.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:CTRL}} 不放：这个场景的每一页都在 GRID 上。
say.en: Hold {{key:CTRL}}: every page of the scene is on the GRID.

steps.demo: down CTRL; wait 30; shot; up CTRL

say.zh: 按住 {{key:CTRL}}，点一格：直接去那一页。
say.en: Hold {{key:CTRL}} and tap a cell: straight to that page.

steps.demo: down CTRL; wait 30; tap G1; wait 6; shot; up CTRL

lead.zh: 轨道就像乐队里的乐手：一个打鼓，一个弹琴，一个弹贝斯……各弹各的，合起来就是一首歌。鸣片有 4 条轨道，就是 4 个乐手，每人一种颜色。
lead.en: A track is like a player in a band: one on drums, one on keys, one on bass… each plays their own part, and together they make the song. Cardenza has 4 tracks: 4 players, a colour each.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:TAB}}：下一条轨道。屏幕最上面的颜色跟着变。
say.en: Tap {{key:TAB}}: the next track. The colour at the top of the screen follows.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}} 不放：GRID 上一列一条轨道。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}}: the GRID shows the tracks, a column each.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; shot; up TAB

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}，点第 1 行的一格：去那条轨道。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap a cell of the top row: that track.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G3; wait 6; shot; up TAB

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}，点 GRID 1：回到 {{track:1}}，鼓。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 1: back to {{track:1}}, the drums.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G1; up TAB

lead.zh: 这五课一步一步做出一首完整的歌。先从鼓开始：底鼓、军鼓、闭镲，一段鼓点。
lead.en: These five lessons build a whole song, step by step. First the drums: kick, snare and hi-hat, one beat.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：进入 {{scene:SEQ}}，写节奏的地方。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: {{scene:SEQ}}, where beats are written.

say.zh: 这一页是鼓机，一列一种鼓。按住第 1 列最上面的键（底鼓 BD）不放，点 GRID 1、5、9、13：底鼓放在这 4 步上。
say.en: This page is a drum machine, a drum per column. Hold the top key of column 1 (the kick, BD) and tap GRID 1, 5, 9 and 13: the kick on those 4 steps.

steps.demo: down r0c1; wait 10; tap G1; tap G5; tap G9; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c1; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：绿线走到哪一格，哪一格就响。让它一直播着。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: whichever step the green line reaches sounds. Leave it playing.

say.zh: 按住第 2 列最上面的键（军鼓 SD），点 GRID 5、13：军鼓放在第 5、13 步。
say.en: Hold the top key of column 2 (the snare, SD) and tap GRID 5 and 13: the snare on steps 5 and 13.

steps.demo: down r0c2; wait 10; tap G5; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c2; wait 20

say.zh: 闭镲也一样：按住第 3 列最上面的键（CH），点 GRID 3、7、11、15。
say.en: The hi-hat the same way: hold the top key of column 3 (CH) and tap GRID 3, 7, 11 and 15.

steps.demo: down r0c3; wait 10; tap G3; tap G7; tap G11; tap G15; wait 10; up r0c3; wait 20

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。这段鼓点就是 P01，机器自动存着。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again: stop. This beat is P01, kept on the device.

lead.zh: 一首歌不止一段。每一段叫一个 Pattern：把 P01 复制成 P02，再让它更热闹，留给副歌。
lead.en: A song has more than one part. Each part is a pattern: copy P01 into P02 and make it busier, for the chorus.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 PATTERN 页。一格是一段 Pattern，现在只有 P01。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the PATTERN page. A cell is a pattern; so far there is P01.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:FN}}，按 D 键：复制 P01，得到一模一样的 P02。
say.en: Hold {{key:FN}} and press D: P01 copied into P02.

steps.demo: down FN; wait 20; tap r2c4; up FN; wait 10

say.zh: 点 GRID 2：换到 P02。
say.en: Tap GRID 2: switch to P02.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 两下：回到鼓机页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} twice: back to the drum machine.

steps.demo: tap CTRL; wait 10; tap CTRL; wait 10

say.zh: 按住第 3 列最上面的键（闭镲 CH），点 GRID 1、5、9、13：镲多了一倍，P02 更热闹。
say.en: Hold the top key of column 3 (the hi-hat, CH) and tap GRID 1, 5, 9 and 13: twice the hi-hat, a busier P02.

steps.demo: down r0c3; wait 10; tap G1; tap G5; tap G9; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c3; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：听 P02。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: hear P02.

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again: stop.

lead.zh: T3 是电钢琴。打开和弦，一个键就是一个和弦：写两个，Am 和 F。
lead.en: T3 is an electric piano. With the chord on, a key is a whole chord: write two, Am and F.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}，点 GRID 3：到 {{track:3}}，电钢琴。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 3: {{track:3}}, the electric piano.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G3; up TAB; wait 10

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}} 两下：到 {{scene:INSTR}}，这条轨的声音。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}} twice: {{scene:INSTR}}, the track's sound.

steps.demo: tap ESC; wait 10; tap ESC; wait 10

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 CHORD 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the CHORD page.

say.zh: 点 CHORD（GRID 1）：和弦打开了。
say.en: Tap CHORD (GRID 1): the chord is on.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：回到 {{scene:SEQ}}，写和弦。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: back to {{scene:SEQ}} to write the chords.

say.zh: 按住 A 键（下面一行第 6 个白键）不放，点 GRID 1、4、7：三下 Am 和弦。
say.en: Hold the A key (6th white key of the lower row) and tap GRID 1, 4 and 7: three Am chords.

steps.demo: down r3c6; wait 10; tap G1; tap G4; tap G7; wait 10; up r3c6; wait 10

say.zh: 重复上一步，换成 F 键（第 4 个白键）：按住 F，点 GRID 9、12、15。
say.en: The step before again, with the F key (4th white key): hold F and tap GRID 9, 12 and 15.

steps.demo: down r3c4; wait 10; tap G9; tap G12; tap G15; wait 10; up r3c4; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：鼓和电钢琴一起。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: drums and piano together.

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again: stop.

lead.zh: T2 是 Juno 合成器，用它写一段旋律：6 个音，全是白键。
lead.en: T2 is a Juno synth: write a tune on it, 6 notes, all white keys.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}}，点 GRID 2：到 {{track:2}}，Juno 合成器。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 2: {{track:2}}, the Juno synth.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G2; up TAB; wait 10

say.zh: 按住 A 键（上面一行第 6 个白键）不放，点 GRID 1：旋律的第一个音。
say.en: Hold the A key (6th white key of the upper row) and tap GRID 1: the tune's first note.

steps.demo: down r1c6; wait 10; tap G1; wait 10; up r1c6; wait 10

say.zh: 重复上一步，照着图写完剩下 5 个音：
say.en: The step before again, for the other 5 notes as the picture shows:

steps.keys: r1c5 r1c3 r1c4 r1c1 G4 G7 G12 G9 G15
steps.demo: down r1c5; wait 6; tap G4; up r1c5; down r1c3; wait 6; tap G7; tap G12; up r1c3; down r1c4; wait 6; tap G9; up r1c4; down r1c1; wait 6; tap G15; up r1c1; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：鼓、电钢琴、旋律一起。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: drums, piano and tune together.

say.zh: 再按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again: stop.

lead.zh: 选一个调，弹什么都在调上。
lead.en: Pick a scale; whatever you play stays in it.

say.zh: 随便弹几个琴键：有的音放在一起很好听，有的却怎么听都不对劲，像是跑调了。有没有办法让每个键都好听、不跑调？
say.en: Play a few keys at random: some notes sound good together, others just sound wrong, out of tune. Is there a way for every key to sound right?

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 12; tap r2c2; wait 12; tap r3c4; wait 12; tap r2c5; wait 12; tap r3c7

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}}，按 GRID 第 1 列：进入 {{scene:SETUP}}。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}} and press GRID column 1: {{scene:SETUP}}.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; shot; tap G1; up ESC

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 两下：翻到 KEYS 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} twice: the KEYS page.

say.zh: 点 SCALE（GRID 2）：选中它。
say.en: Tap SCALE (GRID 2): it is selected.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：换一个音阶。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: another scale.

say.zh: 点 LAYOUT（GRID 1）：选中它。
say.en: Tap LAYOUT (GRID 1): it is selected.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：换成 SCALE。现在每个键都在调上，怎么按都不会错。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: SCALE. Now every key is in the scale; nothing you press is wrong.

say.zh: 弹一弹：每个键都好听了。
say.en: Play: every key sounds right now.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c2; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：回到刚才的地方。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: back to where you were.

lead.zh: 按一个键，响一串。
lead.en: One key, many notes.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 CHORD 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the CHORD page.

say.zh: 点 CHORD（GRID 1）：和弦打开了。
say.en: Tap CHORD (GRID 1): the chord is on.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：换一种和弦。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: another chord.

say.zh: 按一个琴键：一下响了好几个音，这就是和弦。屏幕上的琴键也一起亮。
say.en: Press a key: several notes at once, that is a chord. The keys on the screen light up together.

steps.demo: down r3c1; wait 10; shot; up r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c3

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 ARP 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the ARP page.

say.zh: 点 ARP（GRID 1）：琶音打开了。
say.en: Tap ARP (GRID 1): the arpeggiator is on.

say.zh: 按住一个琴键：和弦的音一个一个弹出来。
say.en: Hold a key: the chord's notes come one after another.

steps.demo: down r3c1; wait 60; shot; wait 20; up r3c1

lead.zh: 材料齐了：鼓的 P01 和 P02、电钢琴、旋律。在 SONG 页把它们排成前奏、主歌、副歌、尾声。
lead.en: Everything is ready: the drums' P01 and P02, the piano, the tune. On the SONG page, put them in a row: intro, verse, chorus, outro.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}}：进入 {{scene:TAPE}}，排歌的地方。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}}: {{scene:TAPE}}, where the song is put together.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}}：到 SONG 页。一列是歌的一段，从左往右播；一行是一条轨。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}}: the SONG page. A column is a part of the song, played left to right; a row is a track.

say.zh: 点 + 那一列（GRID 1）：加第一段，前奏。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 1): the first part, the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:SUB}} 两下：{{track:1}} 换成 --，前奏先不要鼓。
say.en: Press {{key:SUB}} twice: {{track:1}} becomes --, no drums in the intro.

steps.demo: tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 点这一段的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 5）：选中它。
say.en: Tap this part's {{track:2}} cell (GRID 5): it is selected.

say.zh: 按 {{key:SUB}}：{{track:2}} 也换成 --。前奏只有电钢琴。
say.en: Press {{key:SUB}}: {{track:2}} becomes -- too. The intro is just the piano.

say.zh: 再点一次这一格（GRID 5），切到小节数，按 {{key:ADD}}：前奏播 2 遍（x2）。
say.en: Tap the cell again (GRID 5) to switch to its bars, then press {{key:ADD}}: the intro plays twice (x2).

steps.demo: tap G5; wait 10; tap ADD; wait 10

say.zh: 再点一次这一格（GRID 5）：回到 Pattern。
say.en: Tap the cell once more (GRID 5): back to its pattern.

say.zh: 点 + 那一列（GRID 2）：加第二段，主歌。它先照抄前奏。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 2): the second part, the verse. It starts as a copy of the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：{{track:1}} 换成 P01，鼓进来了。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: {{track:1}} on P01, in come the drums.

say.zh: 再点一次这一格（GRID 2），切到小节数，按 {{key:ADD}} 两下：主歌播 4 遍。
say.en: Tap the cell again (GRID 2) for its bars, then {{key:ADD}} twice: the verse plays 4 times.

steps.demo: tap G2; wait 10; tap ADD; wait 6; tap ADD; wait 10

say.zh: 再点一次这一格（GRID 2）：回到 Pattern。
say.en: Tap the cell once more (GRID 2): back to its pattern.

say.zh: 点 + 那一列（GRID 3）：加第三段，副歌。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 3): the third part, the chorus.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}}：{{track:1}} 换成 P02，鼓更热闹。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}}: {{track:1}} on P02, busier drums.

say.zh: 重复第 5–6 步，这次按 {{key:ADD}}：点这一段的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 7），按 {{key:ADD}}，旋律进来了。
say.en: Steps 5–6 again, with {{key:ADD}}: tap this part's {{track:2}} cell (GRID 7), press {{key:ADD}}: in comes the tune.

steps.demo: tap G7; wait 10; tap ADD; wait 6

say.zh: 点 + 那一列（GRID 4）：加最后一段，尾声。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 4): the last part, the outro.

say.zh: 重复第 4 步：按 {{key:SUB}} 两下，{{track:1}} 换成 --。
say.en: Step 4 again: {{key:SUB}} twice, {{track:1}} becomes --.

steps.demo: tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 重复第 5–6 步：点这一段的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 8），按 {{key:SUB}}，{{track:2}} 也换成 --。
say.en: Steps 5–6 again: tap this part's {{track:2}} cell (GRID 8), press {{key:SUB}}: {{track:2}} becomes -- too.

steps.demo: tap G8; wait 10; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 再点一次这一格（GRID 8），切到小节数，按 {{key:SUB}} 两下：尾声播 2 遍。
say.en: Tap the cell again (GRID 8) to switch to its bars, then press {{key:SUB}} twice: the outro plays twice.

steps.demo: tap G8; wait 10; tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; wait 10

say.zh: 点第一段的 {{track:1}} 格（GRID 1）：回到前奏。
say.en: Tap the first part's {{track:1}} cell (GRID 1): back to the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:OK}}：歌从前奏开始（SONG 模式）。
say.en: Press {{key:OK}}: the song starts from the intro (SONG mode).

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}}：听你的第一首歌。前奏、主歌、副歌、尾声，播完从头再来。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}}: your first song. Intro, verse, chorus, outro, then from the top again.

say.zh: 听完一遍，按 {{key:PLAY}}：停。这就是你的第一首歌，机器自动存着。
say.en: Once you have heard it through, press {{key:PLAY}}: stop. That is your first song, kept on the device.

lead.zh: 鸣片插上电先运行启动器：装固件、换固件、更新都在这里。
lead.en: The first thing a Cardenza runs is the Launcher: installing, switching and updating firmware all happen there.

say.zh: 插上 USB 线就开机。装过固件的话，203 标志下面写着「按 FN 进入 Launcher」，大约一秒后就进上次用的固件（不想这样：系统设置 Settings › 启动 Boot，关掉「启动上次的软件」）。
say.en: Plugging in the USB cable switches it on. With firmware installed, the line under the 203 logo says Press FN to enter Launcher, and about a second later the last firmware starts (to stop that, turn Boot last app off in Settings › Boot).

say.zh: 要停在启动器：按住 {{key:FN}}（键盘左下角）插上 USB 线，看到启动器的主屏幕再松开。在「按 FN 进入 Launcher」的那一秒里按一下 {{key:FN}} 也行。旧的启动器（0.2.0）不认 FN：屏幕亮了以后按一下屏幕左边的 {{key:HOME}}。
say.en: To stay in the Launcher, hold {{key:FN}} (bottom left of the keyboard) while you plug in, and let go once its home screen shows. A press of {{key:FN}} during that second does it too. An older Launcher (0.2.0) ignores FN: once the screen is on, press {{key:HOME}}, left of the screen.

say.zh: 固件正在运行时：有系统菜单的固件（Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起）按一下屏幕左边的 {{key:HOME}}，按 {{key:.}} 选「返回启动器」，再按 {{key:OK}}。没有系统菜单的：拔掉 USB 线，按住 {{key:FN}} 再插上。
say.en: From a running firmware: one with the system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 or newer) opens it with a press of {{key:HOME}}, left of the screen: {{key:.}} to Back to Launcher, then {{key:OK}}. Without the system menu: unplug, hold {{key:FN}} and plug back in.

say.zh: 插线时千万别按住 {{key:HOME}}：那会进芯片的下载模式（只在网页上刷机时用），屏幕一直不亮。拔掉再插一次就好。
say.en: Never hold {{key:HOME}} while plugging in: that starts the chip's download mode (only for flashing from the website), and the screen stays dark. Unplug and plug in again.

say.zh: 启动器认键帽上印的黄色箭头：{{key:,}} {{key:/}} {{key:;}} {{key:.}} 是左右上下，{{key:OK}} 确认，{{key:ESC}} 返回。主屏幕的卡片左右排开，第一张是本地应用；在主屏幕按 {{key:ESC}} 回到第一张。
say.en: The Launcher goes by the yellow arrows printed on the caps: {{key:,}} {{key:/}} {{key:;}} {{key:.}} are left, right, up and down; {{key:OK}} confirms, {{key:ESC}} goes back. The home screen's cards go side by side, My Apps first; {{key:ESC}} on the home screen goes back to it.

say.zh: 启动器一开始是英文的。换成中文：打开语言（Language，主屏幕的第八张卡片），选简体中文。这些课里写中文名，括号里是英文。
say.en: The Launcher starts in English. Language (the eighth card on the home screen) picks another; these lessons use the English names.

say.zh: 打开一个固件：本地应用（My Apps）→ 选中它 → {{key:OK}}（启动）。
say.en: To open a firmware: My Apps → pick it → {{key:OK}} (Launch).

lead.zh: 最省事：电脑上打开固件的页面，用 USB 线装进鸣片。不用登录，也不用绑定。
lead.en: The easy way: open the firmware's page on a computer and install it over a USB cable. No account, no binding.

say.zh: 在电脑的 Chrome 或 Edge 里打开固件在 203 社区的页面，比如 Cardenza Synth：[cardenza.203.io/community/V6QK28](https://cardenza.203.io/community/V6QK28)。用能传数据的 USB 线把鸣片接到这台电脑，开着就行：停在启动器里或正在运行固件都可以。
say.en: In Chrome or Edge on a computer, open the firmware's page on the 203 community, Cardenza Synth's for example: [cardenza.203.io/community/V6QK28](https://cardenza.203.io/community/V6QK28). Connect the Cardenza with a USB data cable and leave it on, in the Launcher or running a firmware.

say.zh: 在页面上选好渠道（稳定版、开发版……），点「用 USB 线安装」，再点「连接设备并安装」。浏览器问能不能使用 MIDI 设备时点允许：网页靠它让正在运行的固件重启回启动器。第一次还要在列表里选它的串口（USB JTAG/serial debug unit）。
say.en: Choose the channel on the page (stable, dev …), press Install over USB, then Connect and install. Allow MIDI when the browser asks: that is how the page restarts a running firmware into the Launcher. The first time, choose its port in the list (USB JTAG/serial debug unit).

say.zh: 网页下载、写入、校验，装好后鸣片自己重启进新固件。写完之前别拔线，也别关网页。工程、采样和设置在 SD 卡上，不受影响。
say.en: The page downloads, writes and checks it, and the Cardenza restarts into the new firmware. Keep the cable in and the page open until it is done. Projects, samples and settings are on the SD card and stay as they are.

say.zh: 网页说「在设备上回到启动器」（启动器又启动了固件，网页没能拦住它）：有系统菜单的固件（Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起）按一下 {{key:HOME}}，选「返回启动器」，看到启动器后在网页上点「连接启动器」，在列表里选它的串口。没有这个菜单的固件：按住 {{key:FN}} 不放，再点「连接启动器」，看到启动器的菜单后松开。
say.en: If the page says Bring the device back to its Launcher (the Launcher started the firmware again before the page could stop it): with the system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 or newer), press {{key:HOME}} and choose Back to Launcher; once the Launcher shows, press Connect to the Launcher on the page and choose its port in the list. A firmware without that menu: hold {{key:FN}}, press Connect to the Launcher, and let go once the Launcher's menu shows.

say.zh: 绑定了这台鸣片以后（[绑定账号](/guide/sign-in/)），固件页的大按钮是「下载并安装」（装着旧版本时是绿色的「升级」）：鸣片停在启动器、连着 Wi-Fi 时自己下载、安装并启动；USB 线安装在它旁边的 ▾ 里。鸣片当时不在线的话，之后会先问「安装来自社区的固件？」：按 {{key:OK}}（安装）。
say.en: Once this Cardenza is bound to you ([Binding your account](/guide/sign-in/)), the page's big button is Download & install (a green Upgrade when an older version is on it): in the Launcher and on Wi-Fi, the Cardenza downloads, installs and starts it by itself; Install over USB moves into the ▾ beside it. If the Cardenza was offline then, it asks Install from the community? first: {{key:OK}} (Install).

lead.zh: 不用电脑：启动器连上 Wi-Fi，就能从 203 社区下载固件。
lead.en: No computer needed: on Wi-Fi the Launcher downloads firmware from the 203 community.

say.zh: 主屏幕翻到应用商店（Store），按 {{key:OK}}。第一次会先列出附近的 Wi-Fi：选你的网络，输入密码，按 {{key:OK}}（也可以先在「Wi-Fi 连接」卡片里连好）。
say.en: On the home screen go to the Store and press {{key:OK}}. The first time it lists the Wi-Fi networks nearby: pick yours, type the password, {{key:OK}} (or join one first in the Wi-Fi Network card).

say.zh: 列表里是 203 社区加精的固件，左边是封面，官方固件的作者前有一个勾；装着的固件有新的稳定版时排在最前，封面角上是绿色的新版本号。选一个，按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: The list is the 203 community's featured firmware, each with its cover; official firmware has a tick before its author, and installed firmware with a newer stable version comes first, the new version in green on its cover's corner. Pick one and press {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 列表里没有的，用代码找：每个固件都有 6 位代码，写在它的社区页面上（Cardenza Synth 是 V6QK28）。在应用商店里直接用键盘打出代码，它就排在最前，按 {{key:OK}}。（启动器 0.3.0：按 {{key:;}} 到最上面一排工具，选 #「代码」，输入代码，再按 {{key:OK}}。）
say.en: Not in the list? Every firmware has a 6-character code on its community page (Cardenza Synth's is V6QK28). Just type the code in the Store: that firmware comes first; press {{key:OK}}. (Launcher 0.3.0: {{key:;}} up to the row of tools, # (Code), type the code, {{key:OK}}.)

say.zh: 选一个渠道，按 {{key:OK}}：稳定版是作者确认可用后发布的；测试版是正式发布前的大改动；开发版由最新代码自动构建，可能不稳定。
say.en: Choose a channel and press {{key:OK}}: stable is what the author released when it was ready; beta is a big change to try before that; dev is built automatically from the newest code and may break.

say.zh: 机器上已经有这个固件时，它问装在哪里：开始选的是旧版本的位置，也就是替换它；按 {{key:/}} 换到空闲空间就另装一份。选「替换」后还会问一次「替换？」，默认是「返回」：按 {{key:,}} 选「替换」，再按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: When it is on the device already, it asks where: it starts on the old version's place, replacing it; {{key:/}} to Free space installs a second copy. Replace asks once more, Replace?, with Back chosen: {{key:,}} to Replace, then {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 等它下载、写入、校验，别拔电。装好后问「已安装」：「启动」马上打开它，「返回」重启回启动器。
say.en: Let it download, write and check, and keep it plugged in. Then it says Installed: Launch opens it, Back restarts into the Launcher.

say.zh: 以后看有没有新版本：本地应用和应用商店里有新稳定版的固件排在最前，带绿色的角；装更新在应用商店最上面一排工具最右边的「更新」。换版本只换固件：工程、采样和设置在 SD 卡上，新版本打开时接着你上次的工程。
say.en: New versions later: in My Apps and the Store, firmware with a newer stable version comes first with a green corner; Updates, the last tool in the row at the top of the Store, installs them. A new version replaces only the firmware: projects, samples and settings are on the SD card, and it opens on your last project.

lead.zh: 绑定后，网站能把固件直接发到这台鸣片，它的启动器也能在网站上升级。用 USB 线安装不需要账号。
lead.en: Bound to your account, the Cardenza takes the firmware the website sends it, and its Launcher can be upgraded from there. Installing over USB needs no account.

say.zh: 先在电脑上登录 [203 社区](https://cardenza.203.io/community/)。鸣片停在启动器里，连着 Wi-Fi。
say.en: First sign in to the [203 community](https://cardenza.203.io/community/) on a computer. Keep the Cardenza in the Launcher, on Wi-Fi.

say.zh: 在启动器里打开账号（Account，主屏幕的第九张卡片），一打开就是网址和登录码；启动器 0.3.0 在系统设置 › 账号里，选「绑定账号」。没连 Wi-Fi 时它会先请你连上。
say.en: Open Account in the Launcher (the ninth card on the home screen): it opens straight on the address and the sign-in code; Launcher 0.3.0 has it in System Settings › Account, where you choose Bind account. Without Wi-Fi it asks you to connect first.

say.zh: 屏幕上是一个网址、一个 8 位登录码（10 分钟内有效）和这台鸣片的设备编号（芯片决定，重新刷机也不变）。在电脑上打开这个网址（[cardenza.203.io/community/activate](https://cardenza.203.io/community/activate)），输入登录码，核对设备编号，点「批准」。
say.en: The screen shows an address, an 8-character sign-in code (good for 10 minutes) and the Cardenza's device number (from its chip: the same after any reflash). Open that address on the computer ([cardenza.203.io/community/activate](https://cardenza.203.io/community/activate)), type the code, check the device number and press Approve.

say.zh: 几秒钟后鸣片显示「账号已绑定」，网站的「我的设备」里就有它了：在那里可以改名或解绑。在网站上解绑后，鸣片的账号页显示「绑定已失效」；鸣片上也能在账号里「解除绑定」。
say.en: A few seconds later the Cardenza says Account bound, and it is in My devices on the website, where you can rename or unbind it. Unbound on the website, the Cardenza's Account page says Binding no longer valid; on the Cardenza, Account › Unbind does the same.

say.zh: 启动器连不上 Wi-Fi？用 USB 线绑定（启动器 0.3.0 起）：网站的「我的设备」›「添加设备」›「用 USB 线」。鸣片开着，用 USB 线接到电脑（Chrome 或 Edge），点「连接设备」，网页把账号写进启动器（正在运行的固件会被重启回启动器）。
say.en: No Wi-Fi for the Launcher? Bind it over USB (Launcher 0.3.0 or newer): My devices › Add a device › With a USB cable on the website. With the Cardenza on, connect it to the computer (Chrome or Edge), press Connect the device, and the page writes your account into the Launcher (a running firmware is restarted into it).

lead.zh: 启动器是鸣片插电后先运行的系统，固件都由它安装和打开。更新只换启动器：装好的固件、SD 卡上的文件和保存的 Wi-Fi 都还在。
lead.en: The Launcher is what a Cardenza runs first when it gets power; it installs and opens every firmware. An update replaces only the Launcher: your firmware, the files on the SD card and the saved Wi-Fi stay.

say.zh: 先回到启动器。固件有系统菜单时（Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起）最快：按一下屏幕左边的 {{key:HOME}}，画面变暗，弹出系统菜单；按 {{key:.}} 选「返回启动器」，再按 {{key:OK}}。鸣片重启，停在启动器的主屏幕。
say.en: First get to the Launcher. With a firmware that has the system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 or newer) it is quickest: press {{key:HOME}}, left of the screen, once; the picture dims and the system menu opens. {{key:.}} to Back to Launcher, then {{key:OK}}. The Cardenza restarts and stays on the Launcher's home screen.

say.zh: 固件没有系统菜单（Cardenza Synth 0.2.0 和更早的版本，很多社区固件）：拔掉 USB 线，按住 {{key:FN}}（键盘左下角）再插上，看到启动器的主屏幕再松开。开机时 203 标志下面写着「按 FN 进入 Launcher」，这时按一下 {{key:FN}} 也行。启动器 0.2.0 不认 FN：屏幕一亮就按一下 {{key:HOME}}。
say.en: A firmware without the system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.0 and older, many community firmware): unplug, hold {{key:FN}} (bottom left of the keyboard) and plug back in; let go when the Launcher's home screen shows. A press of {{key:FN}} while the start screen says Press FN to enter Launcher does it too. Launcher 0.2.0 ignores FN: press {{key:HOME}} once as soon as the screen lights up.

say.zh: 最简单的更新在启动器的主屏幕上（启动器 0.3.0 起，要连 Wi-Fi）：启动器 0.3.0、0.3.1 翻到第七张卡片「更新启动器」（Update Launcher），卡片下面写着现在的版本（0.3.2 起它是最后一张，叫「Launcher 更新」）。按 {{key:OK}}：它向 203 社区问有没有新版本。没连 Wi-Fi 时它说「未连接」：按 {{key:OK}} 选网络、输入密码。
say.en: The easiest update is on the Launcher's home screen (Launcher 0.3.0 or newer, on Wi-Fi): on Launcher 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 go to the seventh card, Update Launcher, with the running version under its name (from 0.3.2 it is the last card). Press {{key:OK}}: it asks the 203 community for a newer one. Without Wi-Fi it says Not connected: {{key:OK}}, pick the network, type the password.

say.zh: 有新版本时，页面上是旧版本 → 新版本和更新说明，比如 0.3.1 → 0.3.2（{{key:;}} {{key:.}} 上下滚动）。按 {{key:OK}}（更新）：它下载、校验，然后自己重启进新的启动器，这时别拔电。0.3.2 的主屏幕换了顺序和名字：本地应用、应用商店、Wi-Fi 连接、文件浏览、U盘模式、远程访问、系统设置、语言、账号，最后一张「Launcher 更新」写着版本 0.3.2，再打开它说「已是最新」。
say.en: With a new version the page shows old → new and the release notes, 0.3.1 → 0.3.2 for example ({{key:;}} {{key:.}} scroll). {{key:OK}} (Update): it downloads and checks it, then restarts into the new Launcher by itself; keep it plugged in. Launcher 0.3.2's home cards come in a new order with new names: My Apps, Store, Wi-Fi Network, Files, USB Drive, Remote Access, Settings, Language, Account, and last Update Launcher, which says Version 0.3.2; opened again it says Up to date.

say.zh: 在网站上升级（启动器 0.3.0 起，鸣片要绑定到你的社区账号）：登录 [203 社区](https://cardenza.203.io/community/)，「我的设备」里这台鸣片的启动器有新版本时，它那一行有绿色的「升级启动器」（比如 0.3.1 → 0.3.2），点它，再点「升级」。鸣片停在启动器、连着 Wi-Fi 时收到（正在运行的固件收不到，先回到启动器）；可能先问「更新 Launcher？」，按 {{key:OK}}（更新）。绑定最简单是用 USB 线（启动器 0.3.0 起）：鸣片接在这台电脑上，「我的设备」›「添加设备」会先给出「用 USB 线绑定」，不用登录码，也不用 Wi-Fi（登录后用 USB 线装完固件，网页也会问要不要「绑定到我的账号」）。也可以用登录码：鸣片连上 Wi-Fi，打开主屏幕的「账号」（启动器 0.3.0：系统设置 › 账号 › 绑定账号），屏幕上是网址、8 位登录码和设备编号，在网站上输入登录码，核对设备编号，点「批准」。
say.en: From the website (Launcher 0.3.0 or newer, with the Cardenza bound to your community account): sign in to the [203 community](https://cardenza.203.io/community/); in My devices, the Cardenza's row shows a green Upgrade Launcher (0.3.1 → 0.3.2, for example) when there is a new version: press it, then Upgrade. In the Launcher and on Wi-Fi the Cardenza gets it (a running firmware does not: get to the Launcher first); it may ask Update Launcher? first: {{key:OK}} (Update). To bind it, the easiest is the USB cable (Launcher 0.3.0 or newer): with the Cardenza on this computer, My devices › Add a device leads with Bind with a USB cable, no code and no Wi-Fi (signed in, the website also offers Bind to my account at the end of an install over USB). Or with a code: on Wi-Fi, open Account on the home screen (Launcher 0.3.0: System Settings › Account › Bind account); it shows an address, an 8-character sign-in code and the device number: type the code on the website, check the device number and press Approve.

say.zh: 启动器 0.2.0 主屏幕上没有「更新启动器」，也不能从网站升级：在 Download Software 里选 203-Launcher，选最新的版本，再选 Install；屏幕问 Update Launcher? 时按 {{key:,}} 选 Update，再按 {{key:OK}}。它下载、重启，之后就是最新的启动器（现在是 0.3.2）。（0.2.0 只有英文，图里是新的启动器开机的样子。）
say.en: Launcher 0.2.0 has no Update Launcher card and cannot be upgraded from the website: in Download Software pick 203-Launcher, the newest version, then Install; when it asks Update Launcher?, {{key:,}} to Update, then {{key:OK}}. It downloads and restarts, and from then on it is the newest Launcher (0.3.2 today). (0.2.0 is in English only; the picture is a new Launcher starting.)

say.zh: 实在不行（启动器坏了、开不了机）：在电脑的 Chrome 或 Edge 里打开社区的[恢复刷机](https://cardenza.203.io/community/recover)，选 Cardenza，用 USB 线写入最新的官方启动器（勾上的话，还有最新的 Cardenza Synth）。它会清掉内部闪存里的一切：装好的所有固件、启动器的设置和保存的 Wi-Fi、账号绑定（以后可以再绑）。SD 卡不受影响。开不了机时，按住屏幕左边的 HOME 插上 USB 线，两秒后松开（屏幕不亮是对的）。
say.en: If nothing else works (a broken Launcher, it does not start): in Chrome or Edge open the community's [Recovery flash](https://cardenza.203.io/community/recover), choose Cardenza, and it writes the newest official Launcher over USB (and the newest Cardenza Synth, if you tick it). It erases everything in the internal flash: every installed firmware, the Launcher's settings and saved Wi-Fi, the account binding (bind it again later). The SD card is not touched. If it does not start: hold HOME, left of the screen, while you plug in, and let go after two seconds (a dark screen is right).

title.zh: 设备连不上、启动器无法更新：用网页刷成最新启动器
title.en: Can't connect or update the Launcher: flash the newest one from the website

lead.zh: 启动器 0.2.0、0.3.0 常常在机器上更新不了：下载太慢，或者连不上服务器。那就用一根 USB 线在网页上刷：只换启动器，装好的固件、SD 卡上的文件、Wi-Fi 和账号绑定都还在。不用登录。
lead.en: Launchers 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 often cannot update themselves: the download crawls, or never reaches the server. Then flash it from the website over a USB cable: only the Launcher is replaced; installed firmware, the files on the SD card, Wi-Fi and the account binding stay. No sign-in needed.

say.zh: 要一台电脑，用 Chrome 或 Edge（手机、Safari 和 Firefox 都不能用 USB 刷机），和一根能传数据的 USB 线（只能充电的线不行）。先拔下鸣片的 USB 线。
say.en: You need a computer with Chrome or Edge (phones, Safari and Firefox cannot flash over USB) and a USB cable that carries data (a charge-only one will not do). First unplug the Cardenza's cable.

say.zh: 按住屏幕左边的 {{key:HOME}}，插上连着电脑的 USB 线，两秒后松开。屏幕不亮是对的：鸣片在烧录模式里等着。
say.en: Hold {{key:HOME}}, left of the screen, while you plug in the cable from the computer, and let go after two seconds. A dark screen is right: the Cardenza waits in download mode.

say.zh: 在电脑的 Chrome 或 Edge 里打开 [203 社区](https://cardenza.203.io/community/)：随便哪一页都行，登录不登录都行。
say.en: In Chrome or Edge on the computer open the [203 community](https://cardenza.203.io/community/): any page, signed in or not.

say.zh: 第一次网页还看不到这台鸣片（浏览器只让网页用你给它选过的串口）：点页面最下面的「设备连不上或无法更新？按住 HOME 插上 USB 线，点这里」。
say.en: The first time the website cannot see the Cardenza yet (the browser only lets a site use ports you chose for it): at the very bottom of the page press Device won’t connect or update? Hold HOME while you plug in the USB cable, then click here.

say.zh: 浏览器弹出串口列表：选它（一般叫 USB JTAG/serial debug unit），点「连接」。列表里没有它：重新按住 {{key:HOME}} 插上线；还是没有，换一根线或者换个 USB 口。选过一次以后，再这样插上，网页自己就能发现它。
say.en: The browser lists the ports: pick it (usually USB JTAG/serial debug unit) and press Connect. Not in the list: hold {{key:HOME}} and plug in again; still not there, try another cable or USB port. Chosen once, the website finds it by itself every time you plug it in this way.

say.zh: 网页右上角弹出「检测到一台在烧录模式的鸣片」。点「刷入最新启动器」。
say.en: Found a Cardenza in download mode pops up at the top right of the page. Press Flash the newest Launcher.

say.zh: 网页下载最新的启动器，看过鸣片的分区，只写入引导程序和启动器，校验，再让它重启；一般不到一分钟。写完之前别拔线，也别关网页。看到「启动器已从 0.2.0 更新到 0.3.2」这样的一行就好了。
say.en: The website downloads the newest Launcher, checks the Cardenza's partitions, writes only the bootloader and the Launcher, verifies them and restarts it; usually under a minute. Keep the cable in and the page open until it is done. A line like The Launcher went from 0.2.0 to 0.3.2 means it worked.

say.zh: 拔下 USB 线再插上（屏幕已经亮了就不用）：启动器启动，装好的固件和文件都还在。以后在主屏幕最后一张卡片「Launcher 更新」里，它自己就能更新。
say.en: Unplug the cable and plug it in again (not needed if the screen is already on): the Launcher starts, with your firmware and files where they were. From now on it updates itself: Update Launcher, the last card on its home screen.

say.zh: 网站发现启动器低于 0.3.1 时也会提醒你：鸣片停在启动器、用 USB 线连着电脑时，或者「我的设备」里绑定的鸣片，弹出「启动器版本过旧」；点「用 USB 线刷成最新启动器」，网页带你做上面这几步。
say.en: The website also tells you when a Launcher is older than 0.3.1: with the Cardenza in its Launcher on this computer's cable, or for a device bound in My devices, The Launcher is too old pops up; Flash the newest Launcher over USB walks you through the steps above.

lead.zh: 鸣片的官方固件是 Cardenza Synth，新版本发布在 203 社区。换版本只换固件：工程、音色、采样和设置都在 SD 卡上，新版本打开时接着你上次的工程。
lead.en: The Cardenza's official firmware is Cardenza Synth; new versions come out on the 203 community. A new version replaces only the firmware: projects, sounds, samples and settings are on the SD card, and it opens on your last project.

say.zh: 先回到启动器：Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起按一下 {{key:HOME}}，按 {{key:.}} 选「返回启动器」，再按 {{key:OK}}。更早的版本没有这个菜单：拔掉 USB 线，按住 {{key:FN}} 再插上，看到主屏幕再松开（见[更新启动器](/guide/update-launcher/)的第 1、2 步）。
say.en: Get to the Launcher first: from Cardenza Synth 0.2.1, press {{key:HOME}}, {{key:.}} to Back to Launcher, then {{key:OK}}. Older versions have no such menu: unplug, hold {{key:FN}} and plug back in, and let go when the home screen shows (steps 1 and 2 of [Updating the Launcher](/guide/update-launcher/)).

say.zh: 有新版本时一眼就能看到（启动器 0.3.2 起）：「本地应用」（My Apps）里 Cardenza Synth 排在最前，封面左上角绿色的 ↑0.2.1 是社区里新的稳定版；「应用商店」里也一样。在本地应用里按 {{key:OK}} 打开的还是装着的旧版本：新版本在应用商店里装。
say.en: From Launcher 0.3.2 you see it at a glance: in My Apps, Cardenza Synth comes first, and the green ↑0.2.1 on its cover's top left corner is the community's newer stable version; the Store shows it the same way. {{key:OK}} in My Apps still opens the old version installed: the new one is installed from the Store.

say.zh: 最简单，在机器上（要 Wi-Fi，所有启动器都行）：「应用商店」（Store；启动器 0.3.1 和更早叫「下载软件」）→ 按 {{key:;}} 到最上面一排工具 → 最右边的「更新」，按 {{key:OK}}。第一次用会先请你连 Wi-Fi。列表里是装着的固件有新版本的：选「安装更新」，它替换旧版本，装好后重启。
say.en: The easiest, on the device (needs Wi-Fi, any Launcher): Store (Download Software on Launcher 0.3.1 and older) → {{key:;}} up to the row of tools → Updates, the last one, {{key:OK}}. The first time it asks you to join Wi-Fi. It lists what has a newer version: choose Install update; it replaces the old version and restarts when done.

say.zh: 想选渠道（比如开发版）：在应用商店的列表里选 Cardenza Synth（有新版本时它排在最前），按 {{key:OK}}，选稳定版或开发版，装在旧版本的位置：「替换？」默认是「返回」，按 {{key:,}} 选「替换」再按 {{key:OK}}。（启动器 0.3.0 起；0.2.0 的列表是旧的目录：Cardenza Synth → 版本 → Install。）
say.en: To pick the channel (the dev build, say): in the Store's list pick Cardenza Synth (first when it has a new version), {{key:OK}}, stable or dev, and the old version's place: Replace? starts on Back, so {{key:,}} to Replace, then {{key:OK}}. (Launcher 0.3.0 or newer; 0.2.0's list is the old catalog: Cardenza Synth → a version → Install.)

say.zh: 不用 Wi-Fi，用电脑：在 Chrome 或 Edge 里打开 [Cardenza Synth 的社区页面](https://cardenza.203.io/community/V6QK28)，上面选好稳定版或开发版，点「用 USB 线安装」。不用登录，所有启动器都行。
say.en: Without Wi-Fi, from a computer: open [Cardenza Synth's community page](https://cardenza.203.io/community/V6QK28) in Chrome or Edge, choose stable or dev above, and press Install over USB. No account, any Launcher.

say.zh: 用 USB 线把鸣片接到这台电脑（开着就行，正在运行的 Cardenza Synth 会被网页重启回启动器），点「连接设备并安装」。浏览器问能不能使用 MIDI 设备时允许；第一次还要在列表里选它的串口（USB JTAG/serial debug unit）。装好后它自己重启进新版本。登录了的话，网页还会问要不要「绑定到我的账号」：点一下就绑定，不用登录码（启动器 0.3.0 起）。
say.en: Connect the Cardenza to this computer with a USB cable (on is enough: the page restarts a running Cardenza Synth into its Launcher) and press Connect and install. Allow MIDI when the browser asks; the first time, choose its port in the list (USB JTAG/serial debug unit). Then it restarts into the new version. Signed in, the page also offers Bind to my account: one press, no code (Launcher 0.3.0 or newer).

say.zh: 启动器 0.3.2 起，用 USB 线装的新版本直接替换旧版本，网页上写着「已替换」和两个版本。更早的启动器会在空闲空间里另装一份，旧版本还在：在已装软件里选旧的那个，按 {{key:/}} 到 ⋯，{{key:OK}}，选「删除」。空间不够时先删掉旧版本再装，或者先更新启动器。
say.en: From Launcher 0.3.2 an install over USB replaces the old version, and the page says Replaced with both versions. Older Launchers put another copy in free space and the old version stays: in Software Launcher pick the old one, {{key:/}} to ⋯, {{key:OK}}, Delete. When there is no room, delete the old version first, or update the Launcher first.

say.zh: 绑定了社区账号的鸣片（启动器 0.3.0 起；怎么绑定见[更新启动器](/guide/update-launcher/)的第 5 步）：登录后，固件页的大按钮变成绿色的「升级」（还没装过时是「下载并安装」）：鸣片停在启动器、连着 Wi-Fi 时自己下载，替换旧版本并启动（正在运行的固件收不到：先按 {{key:HOME}} 选「返回启动器」）。鸣片当时不在线的话，之后会先问「安装来自社区的固件？」：按 {{key:OK}}（安装）。
say.en: With the Cardenza bound to your community account (Launcher 0.3.0 or newer; binding is step 5 of [Updating the Launcher](/guide/update-launcher/)): signed in, the page's big button is a green Upgrade (Download & install when it is not installed yet): in the Launcher and on Wi-Fi the Cardenza downloads it, replaces the old version and starts it (a running firmware gets nothing: press {{key:HOME}} and choose Back to Launcher first). If it was offline then, it asks Install from the community? first: {{key:OK}} (Install).

say.zh: 用 .bin 文件（所有启动器都行）：「用 USB 线安装」右边的 ▾ →「下载 .bin 到电脑」。
say.en: With a .bin file (any Launcher): the ▾ beside Install over USB → Download the .bin to this computer.

say.zh: 在启动器的「U盘模式」（USB Drive；启动器 0.3.0 和更早叫 USB 模式）里，SD 卡在电脑上是一个 U 盘：把 .bin 拷进去，在电脑上弹出，按 {{key:ESC}}。然后「文件浏览」（Files）→ 选中它 → {{key:OK}}（安装），装在旧版本的位置（替换）。
say.en: In the Launcher's USB Drive (USB Mode on Launcher 0.3.0 and older) the SD card is a drive on the computer: copy the .bin onto it, eject it on the computer, {{key:ESC}}. Then Files → the file → {{key:OK}} (Install), into the old version's place (Replace).

lead.zh: 203 社区里还有别人做的固件：合成器、音序器、游戏、工具……装进鸣片后和 Cardenza Synth 并排放着，在启动器的「本地应用」里换着用。
lead.en: The 203 community also has firmware other people made: synths, sequencers, games, tools… Installed, they sit beside Cardenza Synth, and you switch between them in the Launcher's My Apps.

say.zh: 在电脑上打开 [203 社区的固件列表](https://cardenza.203.io/community/firmware)，左边选鸣片 Cardenza，点开一个，比如 GLIDE。社区里的固件没有经过 203 审核：装之前看看说明和讨论。
say.en: On a computer open the [203 community's firmware list](https://cardenza.203.io/community/firmware), choose Cardenza on the left and open one, GLIDE for example. Community firmware is not reviewed by 203: read its description and discussion first.

say.zh: 最简单：在它的页面上点「用 USB 线安装」，再点「连接设备并安装」（Chrome 或 Edge，用 USB 线接上鸣片，不用登录，所有启动器都行）。它装在空闲空间里，不动 Cardenza Synth；装好后鸣片直接进新固件。
say.en: The easiest: on its page press Install over USB, then Connect and install (Chrome or Edge, the Cardenza on a USB cable, no account, any Launcher). It goes into free space and leaves Cardenza Synth alone; then the Cardenza starts the new firmware.

say.zh: 回到别的固件：先回到启动器（固件有系统菜单时按一下 {{key:HOME}}，选「返回启动器」；没有的，比如很多社区固件，拔掉 USB 线，按住 {{key:FN}} 再插上），在「本地应用」（My Apps）里选一个，按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: To go back to another firmware: get to the Launcher (with a system menu, press {{key:HOME}} and choose Back to Launcher; without one, as in many community firmware, unplug, hold {{key:FN}} and plug back in), then My Apps, pick one, {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 在机器上（要 Wi-Fi，启动器 0.3.0 起）：「应用商店」（Store）里是社区加精的固件。选一个，按 {{key:OK}}，选渠道，再按 {{key:OK}}；问装在哪里时选「空闲空间」，免得替换别的固件。
say.en: On the device (needs Wi-Fi, Launcher 0.3.0 or newer): the Store lists the community's featured firmware. Pick one, {{key:OK}}, a channel, {{key:OK}}; if it asks where, choose Free space so nothing else is replaced.

say.zh: 列表里没有的（没加精），用它的 6 位代码，写在它的社区页面上（GLIDE 是 B6S4QV）。
say.en: Not in the list (not featured)? Use its 6-character code, on its community page (GLIDE's is B6S4QV).

say.zh: 在应用商店里直接用键盘打出代码，它就排在最前，按 {{key:OK}}（启动器 0.3.1 起）。启动器 0.3.0：按 {{key:;}} 到最上面一排工具，选 #（代码），输入代码，按 {{key:OK}}。启动器 0.2.0 不认代码：用电脑装。
say.en: Type the code on the keyboard in the Store: that firmware comes first; {{key:OK}} (Launcher 0.3.1 or newer). Launcher 0.3.0: {{key:;}} up to the row of tools, # (Code), type it, {{key:OK}}. Launcher 0.2.0 knows no codes: install from a computer.

say.zh: 绑定了社区账号的鸣片（启动器 0.3.0 起；怎么绑定见[更新启动器](/guide/update-launcher/)的第 5 步）：登录后它的页面上的大按钮是「下载并安装」：鸣片停在启动器、连着 Wi-Fi 时自己下载、安装并启动（正在运行的固件收不到，先回到启动器）；当时不在线的话之后会先问「安装来自社区的固件？」，按 {{key:OK}}（安装）。
say.en: With the Cardenza bound to your community account (Launcher 0.3.0 or newer; binding is step 5 of [Updating the Launcher](/guide/update-launcher/)): signed in, its page's big button is Download & install: in the Launcher and on Wi-Fi the Cardenza downloads, installs and starts it (a running firmware gets nothing: get to the Launcher first); if it was offline then, it asks Install from the community? first: {{key:OK}} (Install).

say.zh: 用 .bin 文件（所有启动器都行）：▾ →「下载 .bin 到电脑」，在「U盘模式」（启动器 0.3.0 和更早叫 USB 模式）里拷进 SD 卡，弹出后按 ESC，再在「文件浏览」里选中它，按 OK（安装），装进空闲空间。装坏了、开不了机：用社区的[恢复刷机](https://cardenza.203.io/community/recover)（会清掉装好的所有固件）。
say.en: With a .bin file (any Launcher): ▾ → Download the .bin to this computer, copy it onto the SD card in USB Drive (USB Mode on Launcher 0.3.0 and older), eject, ESC, then pick it in Files and press OK (Install), into free space. If something breaks and it does not start: the community's [Recovery flash](https://cardenza.203.io/community/recover) (it erases every installed firmware).

lead.zh: 把电脑上的文件拷进 SD 卡，或者从卡上装 .bin 固件。
lead.en: Copy files from a computer to the SD card, or install a .bin firmware from the card.

say.zh: 主屏幕翻到 U盘模式（USB Drive，启动器 0.3.0 和更早叫 USB 模式），按 {{key:OK}}，用 USB 线接上电脑：SD 卡在电脑上就是一个 U 盘。
say.en: On the home screen go to USB Drive (USB Mode on Launcher 0.3.0 and older), press {{key:OK}} and connect a computer: the SD card shows up there as a drive.

say.zh: 拷完先在电脑上弹出（推出）这个盘，再按 {{key:ESC}} 回到启动器。电脑还开着它时启动器会先提醒你，免得文件没写完。
say.en: When the files are copied, eject the drive on the computer first, then {{key:ESC}} back to the Launcher. If the computer still has it open, the Launcher warns you first, so no file is left half written.

say.zh: 卡上的 .bin 固件这样装：文件浏览（Files）→ 选中它 → {{key:OK}}（右边的 ↓ 就是安装），然后和应用商店里一样选装在哪里。
say.en: To install a .bin firmware from the card: Files → pick it → {{key:OK}} (the ↓ at its right is Install), then choose where as in the Store.

say.zh: 也可以不进 U盘模式：在电脑的 Chrome 或 Edge 里打开 203 社区的[设备文件](https://cardenza.203.io/community/files)页。鸣片停在启动器的主屏幕，用 USB 线接上，点「连接设备」，就能浏览、上传、下载 SD 卡（TF 卡）上的文件。
say.en: Or without USB Drive: open the 203 community's [Device files](https://cardenza.203.io/community/files) page in Chrome or Edge. Leave the Cardenza on the Launcher's home screen, connect it and press Connect device to browse, upload and download the files on its SD (TF) card.

lead.zh: 开不了机、刷坏了，或者想回到出厂的样子：网站把官方启动器和官方固件一起刷回去。不用登录。
lead.en: Won't start, flashed wrong, or want it as it came: the website writes the official Launcher and firmware back. No account needed.

say.zh: 在电脑的 Chrome 或 Edge 里打开 203 社区的[恢复刷机](https://cardenza.203.io/community/recover)，选 Cardenza。它会清掉机器内部闪存里的一切：装好的固件、启动器的设置和保存的 Wi-Fi、账号绑定（以后可以再绑定）。SD 卡不受影响：工程、音色和采样都还在。
say.en: In Chrome or Edge open the 203 community's [Recovery flash](https://cardenza.203.io/community/recover) and choose Cardenza. It erases everything in the device's internal flash: installed firmware, the Launcher's settings and saved Wi-Fi, the account binding (bind it again later). The SD card is left alone: projects, sounds and samples stay.

say.zh: 还能开机：停在启动器里，用 USB 线接上电脑，网页的连接会让它自己重启进下载模式。正在运行有系统菜单的固件（Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起）时，也可以按一下 {{key:HOME}}，选最后一项「下载模式」。
say.en: If it still starts: stay in the Launcher and connect it to the computer; the page's Connect restarts it into download mode by itself. A running firmware with the system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 or newer) gets there too: press {{key:HOME}} and choose the last item, Download mode.

say.zh: 开不了机：拔掉 USB 线，按住屏幕左边的 {{key:HOME}} 插上，两秒后松开。屏幕不亮是对的：它在下载模式里等着。
say.en: If it won't start: unplug, hold {{key:HOME}}, left of the screen, while you plug in, and let go after two seconds. A dark screen is right: it is waiting in download mode.

say.zh: 点「选择串口并连接」，在列表里选它的串口（一般叫 USB JTAG/serial debug unit），勾选确认，点「擦除并恢复」。写完之前别拔线，也别关网页。完成后它启动官方启动器；勾了「同时装上 Cardenza Synth」的话，它也已经装好。
say.en: Press Choose the port and connect, pick its port in the list (usually USB JTAG/serial debug unit), tick the confirmation and press Erase and restore. Keep the cable in and the page open until it is done. Then it starts the official Launcher, with Cardenza Synth installed if you ticked Install “Cardenza Synth” too.
